# 🚀 Indeed jobs scraper [PPR]

The Apify actor [`borderline/indeed-scraper`](https://apify.com/borderline/indeed-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.187**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Pay per result - Fast and reliable Indeed Job Scraper! 🚀 Extract job listings with company details effortlessly with advanced filters, avoid blocking, and enjoy lightning-speed execution. Build your analytics, automate searches, or benchmark salaries—all with seamless outputs. Try it now for free

## Pricing

Pay per event — job $0.005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/borderline/indeed-scraper) for current prices.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string \| null | Job title exactly as published by the employer on Indeed. |
| `normalizedTitle` | string \| null | Indeed's normalized form of the job title, useful to group postings that describe the same role under different wordings. |
| `displayTitle` | string \| null | Job title as Indeed renders it on the listing page. Often shorter than the title published by the employer. |
| `jobKey` | string \| null | Indeed's unique identifier for the posting (the `jk` parameter of the job URL). Use it as the primary key when deduplicating or upserting into your own database. |
| `refNum` | string \| null | The employer's own reference for this posting, as carried by the job feed. Lets you match a posting against an applicant tracking system. |
| `jobUrl` | string \| null | Canonical Indeed URL of the job posting. |
| `applyUrl` | string \| null | Direct application link, when the employer applies off-site (ATS, career site, job board). Absent for Indeed Apply postings. |
| `isEasyApply` | boolean \| null | True when the posting accepts Indeed's one-click application. Absent when the information could not be retrieved for this run. |
| `easyApplyUrl` | string \| null | Direct one-click application endpoint on Indeed. Different from the apply URL above, which points at the posting page. |
| `campaignCount` | number \| null | Number of funded advertising campaigns attached to this posting. 0 means the employer is not paying to promote it. Unlike the sponsored flag, this does not depend on the search query that found the job. |
| `source` | string \| null | Where Indeed originally aggregated the listing from: the employer's own career site, an ATS or a partner job board. |
| `feedSourceType` | string \| null | Who published the posting to Indeed: EMPLOYER for a direct employer posting, RECRUITER when it came through a staffing agency. |
| `sourceEmployerName` | string \| null | Employer name as declared by the source feed. Differs from the company name on roughly a third of postings, typically when an agency posts on a client's behalf. |
| `jobType` | array \| null | Contract types attached to the posting, as labelled by Indeed in the listing's locale. |
| `occupation` | array \| null | Indeed's normalized occupation taxonomy for the role. Useful to group postings across job titles. |
| `occupationMostLikely` | array \| null | The occupation Indeed considers most likely for this posting, from the same taxonomy as the occupation field. Usually one entry, occasionally more. |
| `attributes` | array \| null | Skills, tools, languages and perks extracted by Indeed from the description and shown as tags on the listing. |
| `employerProvidedAttributes` | array \| null | Attributes the employer declared itself, as opposed to the attributes field, which Indeed infers from the posting text. |
| `isRemote` | boolean \| null | True when Indeed flags the posting as remote work. |
| `workingSystem` | array \| null | Work arrangement labels attached to the posting (flextime, shift work, on-site, hybrid...). |
| `shiftAndSchedule` | array \| null | Schedule tags of the posting (days, shifts, weekend availability...). |
| `shifts` | object \| array \| null | Detailed shift plan for hourly and shift-based postings: date ranges, start time, duration, breaks and time zone. |
| `age` | string \| null | Relative freshness label shown on the search results page, in the listing's language. |
| `datePublished` | string \| null | Date the posting was published on Indeed. |
| `scrapedAt` | string \| null | ISO 8601 timestamp of when this record was collected. |
| `postedToday` | boolean \| null | True when the posting was published on the day of the scrape. |
| `isRepost` | boolean \| null | True when the posting is a republication of an earlier one. Separates genuinely new hiring demand from recycled listings. |
| `isLatestPost` | boolean \| null | True when this is the most recent version of the posting. False marks an older copy that the employer has since republished. |
| `isSponsored` | boolean \| null | True when the posting appeared as a paid/sponsored placement in the search results instead of an organic listing. This describes how the job appeared in THIS search: the same jobKey can be sponsored for one query and organic for another. Use it to filter out promoted listings or to track ad placemen |
| `expired` | boolean \| null | True when the posting is no longer accepting applications. |
| `language` | string \| null | ISO 639-1 language code of the posting content. |
| `locale` | string \| null | Locale of the Indeed domain the job was scraped from. |
| `companyName` | string \| null | Employer name as displayed on the posting. |
| `companyUrl` | string \| null | URL of the employer's Indeed company profile. |
| `companyLogoUrl` | string \| null | Direct link to the employer's logo image. |
| `companyHeaderUrl` | string \| null | Direct link to the banner image of the employer's company profile. |
| `companySector` | string \| null | Sector shown on the employer's Indeed company page, in the language of the country searched. |
| `companyAddresses` | array \| string \| null | Office locations listed on the employer's company profile. |
| `companyNumEmployees` | string \| null | Company size bracket declared by the employer. |
| `companyRevenue` | string \| null | Revenue bracket declared by the employer. |
| `companyDescription` | string \| null | Full 'About us' text from the employer's Indeed company profile. |
| `companyBriefDescription` | string \| null | Short employer summary shown at the top of the company profile. |
| `companyPhone` | string \| null | Phone number published on the employer's company profile. |
| `companyFounded` | object \| null | Founding date of the company, as day/month/year parts. Most profiles only expose the year. |
| `companyLinks` | object \| null | External links published on the employer's company profile. |
| `companyCeo` | object \| null | CEO published on the employer's company profile. |
| `rating` | object \| null | Aggregated employee rating of the employer on Indeed. |
| `location` | object \| null | Workplace location of the posting, geocoded by Indeed when available. |
| `salary` | object \| null | Structured compensation for the posting. `salaryText` is what Indeed displays; `salaryMin`/`salaryMax` are the parsed bounds expressed in the unit given by `salaryType`. |
| `benefits` | array \| null | Benefits advertised on the posting. |
| `socialInsurance` | array \| null | Insurance and social coverage items listed on the posting (mostly on non-US domains). |
| `descriptionText` | string \| null | Full job description as plain text, ready for NLP, embeddings or keyword search. |
| `descriptionHtml` | string \| null | Full job description with the original HTML markup (lists, headings, emphasis). |
| `requirements` | array \| null | Qualifications extracted by Indeed, each flagged as required or preferred. |
| `emails` | array \| null | Email addresses found in the job description. Prime lead-generation signal — most postings expose none. |
| `contacts` | array \| null | Recruiter contact blocks published on the posting (mostly on non-US domains). |
| `hiringDemand` | object \| null | Urgency badges shown on the listing. Useful to prioritize outreach or applications. |
| `organicApplyStarts` | number \| null | Number of applications started from organic (non-sponsored) traffic, as reported by Indeed. |
| `scrapingInfo` | object \| null | Where this item came from in the crawl. Lets you rebuild the original ranking of a search or attribute a job back to its input URL. |
| `error` | string \| null | Present only on the single placeholder item pushed when the search returned no result at all. Regular job items never carry this field. |
